causative_construction.description: Causative maku examples contain an ordinary causer subject plus a distinct Voice=Cau personal form representing the causee.
causative_construction.note: Causee forms are intentionally separate from subject_realizations; no unattested causative person cells are generated.

eragu.note: Positive polarity is unmarked in CoNLL-U and normalized to Pos only for generator comparison; incomplete ire tokens without Mood=Ind were not promoted as a separate cell.

maragodu.note: Unmarked positive polarity normalized to Pos only for comparison. cei without VerbForm=Ger and ire without Mood=Ind were treated as incomplete annotation, not new cells.

robustness.method: A licensed cell is supported when the same normalized feature selection and the same surface personal form are directly attested with the predicate. Unmarked CoNLL-U polarity is normalized to Pos only for comparison.
